title: HYP-028 Phase 1: PAPER-133 Yang-Lee boundary-data reproduction PASSED (R_inf = -1.61820 vs -(1+sqrt5)/2, 0.01%; g_1 = 0.72535 vs 0.725073, 0.04%)
method: Sparse-ED reproduction of PAPER-133 (2606.16785v2) projected-partition-function spectroscopy on the periodic PT-symmetric Ising chain H_YL = -sum(sz sz + lambda sx + i h sz), lambda=4. Finite-size exceptional points h_c^L located by bisection on Im(E) of the lowest pair (L=8..18, KrylovKit smallest-real-part Arnoldi); h_c^inf = 1.5587127 from fixed-exponent fit (b=12/5 + L^-4 subleading; free-b gives 2.33-2.37 vs theory y_phi=12/5=2.4). Biorthogonal projections at h=h_c^inf (PT-unbroken at every finite L): Z_{X,i} = <X|Psi_iR><Psi_iL|X>/<Psi_iL|Psi_iR> with eta=parity so left = P*right (real spectrum), X = product (|up>+|down>)/sqrt2 preparation. L=8..20 (2^20 = 1M-dim top rung).

R_inf.method: two-level Richardson (pairwise 1/L intercepts, then geometric tail sum; intercept sequence -1.5423..-1.6065, ratios 0.56->0.72)

g1.paper_value: 0.725339(51) -- our L>=10 value matches the paper's own number

results.Z1_sign: NEGATIVE at every L (the unitarity-forbidden sign; Z_phi real to machine precision, |Im| <= 3e-10 relative)

key_findings: PAPER-133's periodic-chain route to nonunitary boundary data is CONFIRMED at ED scale: the negative excited-to-ground amplitude ratio -- impossible in any unitary CFT -- is reproduced at 0.01% with plain sparse ED plus the eta=parity left-pairing. HYP-028's G4-gate prerequisite is satisfied.

h-sensitivity grows as L^{12/5} (relevant-direction flow): refining h_c^inf by 1.2e-4 visibly moved L>=16 amplitudes. Extrapolation quality is limited by h_c^inf precision before anything else -- pin h_c^inf with the theory-fixed exponent, never a free-b fit alone.

Naive polynomial-in-1/L extrapolation over wide L-windows OVERSHOOTS (curvature at small L; free-power fits gave -1.75); pairwise-linear intercepts + Richardson on the intercept sequence is the stable estimator at these sizes.
Working point must be h_c^inf (PT-unbroken at all finite L) -- everything is regular there; no exceptional-point pathology encountered anywhere in the pipeline.
verdict: PASSED. Phase 2 unlocked: biorthogonal Koo-Saleur elements at the same working point -- product-form c_KS = 2<0_L|H_-2|T_R><T_L|H_+2|0_R>/(norms) with the conformal vacuum |1> = SECOND k=0 state, testing c=-22/5 vs c_eff=2/5.
